data.title: Internationals: How EVERY Premier League club's stars are performing - Premier League
data.content: We look at how players from all 20 clubs are faring for their nations during the international break. The Premier League's Player of the Month for October, Nicolas Jackson, continued his hot scoring streak in the first round of matches of the November international break. The Aston Villa striker, who has netted six goals and registered an assist in his last six Premier League games, was on target as Senegal beat Sudan 4-1 in their Africa Cup of Nations qualifier. Chelsea’s Morgan Rogers was another Premier League player on the scoresheet on Thursday, while AFC Bournemouth's Junior Kroupi made his senior international debut for France. Jackson and Ibrahim Mbaye were both on the scoresheet for Senegal in their 4-1 Africa Cup of Nations qualifier victory over Sudan. James Hill was an unused sub for England in their victory over Croatia, having been called into the senior squad for the first time on Monday as cover for the injured Konsa.
